digest.component_or_area: Verified gate macOS pytest cell, CI workflow
propositions: macOS default-suite pytest step selects -m 'platform_compat and not external' but the platform_compat marker is applied only by tests/conftest.py at collection time, causing zero tests to collect on patchsets predating the auto-marker

Verified gate runs _build-and-test.yml from trusted main against raw patchset trees, so a patchset predating the auto-marker encounters marker selection logic without the marker definition itself, causing pytest exit code 5 (no tests ran)

The defect is a regression introduced by story omphacite-desertlike-coney, which split the contract across workflow (marker selection) and conftest (marker application), creating the tree-skew condition
Fix maps pytest exit code 5 to success only on macOS cells to restore pre-regression tolerance while Ubuntu cells retain rc 5 as a real failure indicator

Patchset 1 triggered a false positive in test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked due to a comment literal path 'tests/conftest.py' being regex-matched; patchset 2 rewrote the comment to 'conftest auto-marker' to resolve
